Follow the blue teaching bubbles that appear throughout the page and select Next to move
from one step to the next.
You can take the tour again at any time by going to Help resources > Learn more and
selecting Take the tour.
You can then start building your query to hunt for threats. The following articles can help you
get the most out of hunting in guided mode:
